threads.body: The Bedrock tests still compare these values with float literals (`40.0`, `250.0`, etc.). Because Python considers `40 == 40.0`, those assertions pass both before and after this change and do not verify the intended telemetry type. Please update the converse and invoke-model coverage to assert that every changed `top_k` extraction path yields an `int`, including the exported span attribute.

threads.body: There is no Portkey test that supplies or asserts `top_k`, so this conversion and its required integer attribute type are currently unprotected. Add request-parameter coverage that passes `top_k` and checks both the emitted value and `isinstance(value, int)`.

The shared public `InferenceInvocation.top_k` field is still declared as `float | None` (`util/opentelemetry-util-genai/.../_inference_invocation.py:144`), while the pinned GenAI convention defines `gen_ai.request.top_k` as `int`. These new integer assignments therefore leave the util API contract inconsistent with both the emitted value and the convention; please change the shared field annotation to `int | None` and cover its emitted attribute type in the util tests.
